name: dataflow
description: Work with a dataflow using an ordered list of inspect, edit, execute, retrieve, or answer actions. Start with a brief reasoning description. Edits do not run the graph; retrieval reads existing results. Batch actions whose arguments are already known. A failure skips later actions; completed edits remain. After an execution failure, inspect and retrieve may still read independent completed results. Answer must be the only action in its call.

reasoning.description: One brief sentence stating the next objective.

actions.description: Actions run in order. Wait for the next turn before making a decision based on a returned result. An answer must be the only action.

anyOf.description: List operator IDs, kinds, and data edges with their ports. Does not execute.
Read an operator's definition, ports, connections and description. Request its registered Python functions when needed.

changes.description: Graph commands: create operator id: expression; update operator id: expression; delete operator id; create edge source.out -> target.port; delete edge source.out -> target.port. One command per line, without leading spaces; Python functions are indented under their operator. Operator expressions have no upstream table arguments. Update supplies the complete definition and preserves connections. Deleting an operator automatically deletes its incident edges. Edges cannot be updated. A failed Edit applies no changes.

anyOf.description: Apply operator create/update/delete commands and edge create/delete commands in changes, with type="edit". Atomic; does not execute.

Run every component of the graph, including disconnected branches, reusing valid cached results. Repair failed operators and connect or delete unused consumers first. Returns status and errors; retrieve tables separately.

Read an existing result: full requests records up to its character cap; narrow large tables first; sample checks layout and example values with a small record view; sample_stats checks distributions and data quality with a small record view plus independently collected, coverage-labeled statistics. Enabled flow evidence is added automatically. Never executes. Check completeness; missing or stale outputs require execute.
Return the final response and end the loop. Must be the only action; base the answer on results already received.
